new_candidates.title: JTAC Trainer
new_candidates.tagline: Voice-first Close Air Support 9-line trainer — speak a 9-line CAS brief, the bomb lands wherever your transmission said it should
new_candidates.description_md:
Real-time voice procedure sim for CAS (close air support) trainees. The trainee surveys a 3D battlefield, speaks a 9-line CAS brief to hog1 — an A-10 pilot agent — and watches the bomb land wherever the transmission said it should. Misread a grid? You get a visible, consequential miss. End the run for an instructor-style debrief.

Air control and CAS voice procedures are critical — they decide life-or-death situations. Realistic training is expensive: live-fire ranges, real aircraft, and instructor time are all bottlenecks. A voice agent removes that bottleneck so trainees can drill scenarios and manoeuvres on demand, no instructor or jet required.

new_candidates.title: ContextGuard
new_candidates.tagline: AI-Powered Rumour Pre-Mortem Engine for Singapore — predicts misinformation before it spreads, arms community leaders with multilingual counter-narratives
new_candidates.description_md:
ContextGuard is a proactive misinformation defense system. Every existing solution — POFMA, CNA fact-checks, chatbots — is reactive: they correct misinformation after it has already spread. ContextGuard predicts what misinformation will emerge before it spreads, and arms trusted community leaders with pre-written counter-narratives in all 4 official Singapore languages.

Singapore's misinformation follows patterns — the same emotional triggers (financial anxiety, racial tension, health fear), the same language communities targeted, the same gap between official communication and public fear. A decade of POFMA notices, MOH corrections, and CNA fact-checks prove this. ContextGuard turns those patterns into predictions.
